prose: A Show HN entry for a face-analysis tool whose model estimates facial attractiveness on a 10-point scale. According to the site, the score is not arbitrary: the model was trained on ratings from 60 people who reviewed thousands of face photos, so its output is meant to reflect shared human rating patterns rather than a single aesthetic opinion. The cached source was very brief, so this summary reflects only that limited material.
highlights: Show HN: an AI model that scores facial attractiveness (e.g. '8.0 / 10')
Trained on ratings from 60 people across thousands of face photos
The pitch is that scores reflect shared human rating patterns, not one opinion
